_approach: Dariacore 'implements aspects of various genres of EDM, such as Jersey club, dubstep, and complextro' and borrows 'the rhythmic intensity of breakcore/jungle' (Wikipedia, Melodigging). This groove chops a breakbeat-style kick/snare pattern — displaced kicks, a snare that drags and doubles unevenly bar to bar — the way a jungle amen break gets re-sliced, at a tempo breakcore rather than jungle would use. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
